description: Trigger precision eval: verify bp-cpp-project-init activates on C++ project infrastructure setup queries (Source/, .Build.cs, .Target.cs) and NOT on BP logic conversion, BP analysis, or C++ codegen queries

cases.query: 우리 프로젝트 아직 BP only인데, C++ 프로젝트로 전환하려고 해. Source 폴더 구조 잡고 기본 클래스 세팅
cases.reason: Korean BP-only project to C++ transition with Source folder setup

cases.query: enable C++ for this Blueprint-only project, set up the Source directory and Build.cs
cases.reason: Routes to module-mapper (higher-priority overlap): Ambiguous: "Source directory and Build.cs" matches module-mapper (lower priority); needs more specific C++ init patterns

cases.query: BP only에서 C++ 프로젝트로 전환해줘. Source 디렉토리 만들고 Target.cs 파일 생성
cases.reason: Korean BP-only to C++ with explicit Source directory and Target.cs creation

cases.query: init C++ project for my Blueprint-only game, I need the basic folder structure
cases.reason: English C++ project initialization with folder structure request

cases.query: C++ 프로젝트 초기화해줘. 아직 Source 폴더가 없어서 NarshaMCP 플러그인을 못 쓰고 있어
cases.reason: Routes to ue-project-init (higher-priority overlap): Ambiguous: "프로젝트 초기화해줘" matches ue-project-init (lower priority)

cases.query: BP_PlayerCharacter를 C++로 변환해야 해. Tick에서 너무 많은 로직 돌리고 있어서 성능이 안 나와
cases.reason: BP logic conversion -> bp-to-cpp, not project init

cases.query: convert BP_WeaponBase to C++ - it has 15 functions and the casting overhead in BP is killing our frame time
cases.reason: BP logic to C++ conversion -> bp-to-cpp
C++ class generation from scratch -> code-generation

cases.query: BP_InventoryManager를 네이티브로 마이그레이션해야 해. 200개 이상 노드에 ForEach 루프가 5개 있어서 GC 스파이크 심함
cases.reason: BP logic migration to C++ -> bp-to-cpp
